chapter.verse: A lungsim sung a siangtho, thutangte tungah Pasian hoih takpi hi.
Ahih hangin kei ka hih leh ka khete kisuipuk dektak a, ka khe taal dektak hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh migilote’ daupaina ka muh ciangin mi kihisakte ka eng hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in nat velvalna thuak lo uh a, a pumpi uh cidamin zol hilhial hi.
Amaute in midangte bangin haksatna thuak lo uh a, amaute in midangte bangin gimna ngah lo uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in kiphatsakna khainiang bangin ok uh a, ngongtatna puan bangin silh uh hi.
A lungsim panun gitlohna pusuak sak uh a, a ngaihsutna uh gitlohna tawh dimlet hi.
Amaute in mi thusim loin elpau uh a, kiliatsakna tawh sucip dingin mi tawng uh hi.
Amaute’ gensiatna in vantung ban a, kiliatsakna tawh leitungah thu gen kawikawi uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mite kihei-in amaute phat uh a, amau’ mawhna zong lo uh hi.
Amaute in, “Pasian in bangci theih ding ahi hiam? Sang Penpa in phawk ding ahi hiam?” ci uh hi.
En un, hihte migilo ahi hi; a tawntungin nuam takin om hithiat uh a, amaute a hauhna uh khang semsem hi.
Ka lungsim siang sak a, dikna tawh ka khutte ka sil siang hangin phattuamna om lo hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh sunthapai-in gimna ka thuak a, zingsang simin hong kithuhilh hi.
“Hih bangin thu gen ning,” a ci hi leng, nangma mite tunga thutak lo ka suak ding hi.
Ahih hangin, hih thu a bangci hiam ci-a ka ngaihsut ciangin kei adingin a lunggim-huai mahmah nasep khat hong suak a,
Pasian’ biakinn sungah ka pai ciangin a thu tawpna dongte ka tel hi.
Nangmah in amaute mun nalna-ah na koih takpi a, a sia dingin amaute na tuksak hi.
Tomno sungin amaute kisusia-in, launa in nilkhia mang!
Amaute pen mi khat in mang a mat tawh kibang a, na khan’lawh ciangin amaute a bangci hiam cih na phawk nawn kei hi.
Ka lung khamin ka lungsim hong nat ciangin,
keimah hai-in bangmah ka thei kei a, nangma mai-ah ganhing tawh ka kibang hi.
Ahih hangin nangmah tawh ka omkhawm ngitnget a, ka khut taklam-in nong len hi.
Nangma thugenna tawh keimah lam nong lak a, a nung ciangin minthan’na tawh keimah nong sang ding hi.
Nang sim loh vantungah kua nei ka hi hiam? Nang sim loh ka deih ding leitungah kuamah om lo hi.
Ka lungsim leh ka pumpi zawngkhal kha ding a, ahih hangin Pasian in ka lungsim hatna leh keima aa hi tawntung ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh, en in, nangmah tawh a kigamlate kisia ding a, nangma tunga hong khialte na beisak hi.
Ahih hangin kei adingin Pasian kianga om ding hoih hi; na nasepnate khempeuh ka gen theih nadingin Topa ka Pasian kong bel hi.
